text:
alex: Heads up — canary on dedicated pool shows ~12% tail latency regression after kernel-autotune landed. attaching short logs below

alex: repro was a steady feed of text-generation requests (seq=512, batch=8) for ~30 minutes. CPU ok, GPU util steady, but p99 spiked.

sam: ugh. can you paste the runtime pick reasons? we enabled KPICK_VERBOSE in that build right?

alex: yep. here's the pick trace snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:10Z] pick_id=3341 chosen_kernel=matmul_int8_v2 reason=arch_aware fallback=no seqlen=512 batch=8 est_us=18.4 measured_us=22.1 flags=KPICK_VERBOSE=1 KPICK_AWARE_ARCH=1
[2026-03-17T09:12:10Z] pick_id=3342 chosen_kernel=matmul_fp16_v1 reason=cold_kv_cache seqlen=128 batch=16 est_us=9.2 measured_us=9.4
[2026-03-17T09:12:11Z] pick_id=3343 chosen_kernel=matmul_int8_v2 reason=autotune_score seqlen=512 batch=8 est_us=17.9 measured_us=21.8
```

alex: note the int8_v2 picks show ~22us measured vs 18us estimated.

maria: I also pulled kv metrics — miss rate jumped from 2.1% to 9.8% around the same time the tuner switched kernels. could be layout mismatch or different kv prefetch behavior in that kernel path.

tanya: what batch heuristic was active? we recently flipped seq-aware batching on the canary: REDWOOD_BATCH_HEUR=seq-aware:0.7

alex: correct. env flags on the container: `REDWOOD_KPICK_EXPLAIN=1`, `REDWOOD_KPICK_VERBOSE=1`, `REDWOOD_BATCH_HEUR=seq-aware:0.7`, `REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=1`, `REDWOOD_PICK_SANITY=0`

joe: ci-bot reported the perf guard:
ci-bot: canary-checker: tail_latency +11.9% vs baseline — failing threshold.

sam: hypothesis: autotuner favored int8_v2 because it reduced token-cost on avg, but for seqlen=512 and small batches the memory access pattern increases kv misses and hurts tail latency. int8 kernel's kernel-launch/warp-occupancy may be suboptimal on A100-40 for these params.

maria: agreed. also saw increased memcpy stalls in profiler when int8_v2 was active.

tanya: plan suggestions: (1) add pick-level telemetry fields: chosen_kernel, pick_reason, est_us, measured_us, kv_miss_rate, batch_bucket. (2) enable a temporary pick-safety gate: if measured_us > est_us by >20% for 5 consecutive windows, force fallback to previous kernel. (3) gather batch distribution histogram for the canary window.

sam: I can add telemetry tags quickly. will emit pick_trace events every 500 picks. keys: pick_id, chosen_kernel, reason, est_us, latency_us, gpu_model, seqlen, batch_sz, kv_miss_rate, env_flags.

alex: can you also include a short dump of kernel-specific perf counters? e.g., sm_efficiency, dram_throughput, l2_hit_rate per pick.

sam: yea i can attach those too. might increase log volume but can be rate-limited.

maria: to repro locally: run micro-bench with seqlen=512 batch=1..16, compare int8_v2 vs fp16_v1 on A100-40 and A10G. i suspect the break-even batch size is >12.

joe: quick repro curl: `for i in {1..5000}; do curl -s -H "X-SeqLen:512" -H "X-Batch:8" https://canary.internal/infer; done`

alex: deployed a lightweight patch that enables KPICK_TRACE=1 and logs kernel pick every 1000 requests to cloudwatch; also toggled REDWOOD_PICK_SANITY=1 to force fallback when run >20% est.

sam: can we also add an env flag to force kernel selection override for canary so we can validate rollback with minimal churn? `REDWOOD_KPICK_OVERRIDE=matmul_fp16_v1`

alex: done. overriding to fp16 for the current canary while we collect metrics. rerunning now.

ci-bot: canary-checker: re-run queued (override applied)

maria: preliminary numbers after override — p99 back to baseline within 15 minutes. kv_miss_rate back down to ~2.4%. looks promising.

sam: ok next steps: hook pick telemetry to rollout automation so autotuner changes are gated by pick-level regressions (kv_miss, measured/est ratio, p99 delta). i'll open a PR for telemetry + a follow-up for the safety gate.

tanya: also add a short note to release notes: "autotuner: arch-aware int8 kernel may increase kv misses for mid-long sequences; safety gates enabled"

alex: thanks all. keeping KPICK_TRACE for 24h then we'll revert. dropping logs to "s3://redwood-canary/pick-traces/2067773333/"

maria: :thumbsup:

joe: good catch.

sam: PR incoming with telemetry schema and sample Grafana dashboard panels.

alex: will follow up with full flamegraphs and profiler dumps in the thread when ready.

ci-bot: note: incident not opened — operational follow-up tracked in #incidents if needed.
